title: Bunny Hop
description: Bunny Hop is a native embedded vertical platformer for CardputerZero. Features squash & stretch physics, Landscape and Portrait orientation support (via Pause -> Settings), 8-bit chiptune BGM and SFX, Classic and toddler-friendly Kids Mode (2x platform width, no bats), Shield and Rocket power-ups, 16 unlockable skins, F/Z/X/C controls, and 3-second ESC hold-to-exit countdown.
